sourceEvidence.name: MISO Projects Under Evaluation / MTEP 51364
sourceEvidence.excerpt:
MTEP Project ID: 51364
Project Atom Load Interconnection
Project is needed to support the load interconnection request from IPL.
Interstate Power and Light Company (IPL) has requested to interconnect a new 300 MW load on the Rock Creek – Salem 345 kV line ~3 miles north of the Rock Creek substation. To support this request, ITC Midwest will construct a new 345 kV switching station that will connect to the Rock Creek – Salem 345 kV line and initially provide two 345 kV lines to serve the new load. In addition, a 96 MVAR effective 345 kV capacitor bank will be installed at the new switching station. The new switching station will also provide 2 – 345 kV radial feeds to the customer owned substation/transformers.
Planning Status: M1 - Proposed
Expected ISD: 2028-06-01 00:00:00

assumptions: 모든 요건별 진행률과 점수는 공통 정성 모형의 가정이며 직접 확인한 공정률이 아닙니다.
발췌는 공식 XLSX의 MTEP ID·상태·필요성·시설설명·목표일 셀을 연결한 것입니다.
송전사업의 단계로 고객 전체의 다섯 요건을 확정하지 않고, 해당 고객 요청의 계통 측 진행 단서로만 해석합니다.
이름·위치가 있는 고객 부하 요청에 연결된 최신 보존 계획이 2027-09-30, 2028-01-21, 2028-09-30, 2028-12-31, 2029-01-01, 2029-02-28의 향후 투입일을 제시하고 취소를 표시하지 않아 현재 활성 진행으로 추론합니다. 이는 고객이 철회하지 않았다는 직접 확인이 아닙니다.
limitations: 근거 기준일 이후의 실제 상태를 자동으로 갱신하지 않습니다. 목표 통전일 경과만으로 운영 완료를 판정하지 않습니다.
미공개 계약·인허가·통전 요건을 확인 완료로 저장하지 않습니다. 기존 원문의 실제 취득 시각은 유지했고 2026-10-12에 재검토했습니다.
서로 다른 지원시설·시점의 M1 - Proposed, M2 - Appendix A Approved, M4 - Project in Service가 함께 있습니다. 가장 앞선 시설의 상태를 고객 캠퍼스 전체 완료로 확대하지 않았습니다.
Google과 QTS가 공존하는 산업단지입니다. M4 기존 시설과 신규 M1/M2 확장을 전체 통전으로 묶지 않습니다.

Alliant Energy – Interstate Power and Light Company has requested service for an additional 370 MW of load at the Big Cedar Industrial Park. This 370 MW of additional load will be served from two new radial 345 kV feeds which will provide service to three additional customer owned substations.

Transmission line structure replacements on MidAmerican's section of the Hazleton-Arnold 345 kV line to increase the line rating.
Planning Status: M1 - Proposed
Expected ISD: 2028-12-31 00:00:00

MTEP Project ID: 50943
Kingston Substation Interconnection
The Kingston Substation is needed to reliably serve the newly approved Cedar Crossing Casino and Entertainment Center.
IPL has notified ITC that they will be constructing a new Kingston Substation which will ultimately replace their existing Harrison substation. The new substation will initially connect at 34.5 kV and then be converted to 69 kV as part of the Emerald Isle to Beverly 69 kV conversion. ITC will install two 69 kV busses with two line breakers and a bus tie breaker on the 69kV portion of the new Kingston station. New line taps for Kingston substation to be constructed with T2-4/0 ACSR conductor.
Planning Status: M1 - Proposed
Expected ISD: 2027-12-31 00:00:00

sourceEvidence.name: MISO Projects Under Evaluation / MTEP 51145
sourceEvidence.excerpt:
MTEP Project ID: 51145
New Crossroads 345 kV Transmission Station and Load
To connect a new 300 MW load, it is necessary to construct a new transmission station and interconnect the described transmission lines.
Construct a new 345 kV breaker and a half station and interconnect a new 300 MW (98.61 MVAR) load approximately 3 miles northwest of Carlisle, Indiana.

The new station will bring the existing Gibson – Merom 345 kV, Merom – Worthington 345 kV, and Petersburg – Sullivan 345 kV lines into a new BAAH station. Extending the Merom – Worthington 345 kV line through the site requires the construction of approximately 10 new miles of 345 kV line.

These lines are currently being modified in the existing MTEP 51093 project where they are being brought into the new Gill 345 kV station. This will result in a final topology for these branches being as follows:
1.	Gibson – Crossroads – J1786 – Gill – Merom
2.	Petersburg – Crossroads – Gill – Sullivan
3.	Worthington – Crossroads – Gill - Merom
Planning Status: M2 - Appendix A Approved
Expected ISD: 2027-10-01 00:00:00

assumptions: 모든 요건별 진행률과 점수는 공통 정성 모형의 가정이며 직접 확인한 공정률이 아닙니다.
발췌는 공식 XLSX의 MTEP ID·상태·필요성·시설설명·목표일 셀을 연결한 것입니다.
송전사업의 단계로 고객 전체의 다섯 요건을 확정하지 않고, 해당 고객 요청의 계통 측 진행 단서로만 해석합니다.
이름·위치가 있는 고객 부하 요청에 연결된 최신 보존 계획이 2027-12-01, 2027-12-30, 2028-12-01의 향후 투입일을 제시하고 취소를 표시하지 않아 현재 활성 진행으로 추론합니다. 이는 고객이 철회하지 않았다는 직접 확인이 아닙니다.
limitations: 근거 기준일 이후의 실제 상태를 자동으로 갱신하지 않습니다. 목표 통전일 경과만으로 운영 완료를 판정하지 않습니다.
미공개 계약·인허가·통전 요건을 확인 완료로 저장하지 않습니다. 기존 원문의 실제 취득 시각은 유지했고 2026-10-12에 재검토했습니다.
judgements.identityRationale: 공식 원문의 Project Elkhorn customer load 및 MISO_MTEP_50737, MISO_MTEP_50741를 해당 census 항목과 대조했습니다. 회사명만으로 다른 부지를 병합하지 않았습니다. 별도 기록과의 대응 후보 request:miso-montgomery는 미확정이며 평균 분모의 중복 검토가 필요합니다.

To connect a new 600 MW load, it is necessary to construct a new transmission station and interconnect the described transmission lines.
Expand Hoosier Energy's Milroy 69 kV station with a new 345 kV breaker and a half station called Rush County that interconnects with the 345 kV line between Hanna and Tanners Creek (between Gwynneville and Batesville after LRTP Tranche 2.1). sourceEvidence.name: Lilly Medicine Foundry official groundbreaking account
sourceEvidence.excerpt: That’s where the Lilly Medicine Foundry comes in. We recently broke ground on the facility, a state-of-the-art location combining research, process development, manufacturing, and the latest technology at a single site. Located in Lebanon, Indiana, the Foundry will enable us to research new, optimized ways of producing medicines to help scale global access to clinical trials supply, while reducing environmental impact. The flexible design of the Foundry will support various molecular therapies, including small molecules, biologics and next-generation therapeutics like genetic medicines. This will allow us to meet the needs of complex conditions, like Alzheimer’s disease and chronic pain. The Foundry’s strategic location in the LEAP Lebanon Innovation District will offer close collaboration with other Lilly product development teams in Indianapolis and manufacturing sites in Lebanon to drive faster and smarter innovation across our company.

Load Interconnection

MTEP Project ID: 50779
Riddle 230 kV Station and Line Upgrade
Entergy received a request from a customer adding new load near St Francisville, LA.  These facilities were identified as needed due to the load growth.

P1 Loss of Mcknight – Coly 500 kV line causes a thermal overload on the Fancy Point – Riddle 230 kV line.
Entergy is proposing to construct a new 230 kV station named Riddle to serve a new customer cut into the existing Fancy Point to Ventress 230 kV line near Saint Francisville, LA.

The Riddle 230 kV station will be a breaker and a half substation. The new station has a target ISD in June 2026.

The need to reconductor the Fancy Point to Riddle 230 kV line was also identified to serve this load.
Planning Status: M4 - Project in Service

projectSnapshot.name: TeraWulf Justified Data Campus
projectSnapshot.rawStatus:
TeraWulf Inc. (Nasdaq: WULF) (“TeraWulf” or the “Company”), a vertically integrated owner, developer and operator of large-scale digital infrastructure, today announced that the Kentucky Public Service Commission (“PSC”) has approved the Retail Electric Service Agreement (“RESA”) supporting up to 482 megawatts (“MW”) of electric service for TeraWulf’s Justified Data Campus in Hancock County, Kentucky. The approval represents an important milestone for Justified and, in TeraWulf’s view, validates a strong model for responsible large-scale data center development: securing substantial power capacity while ensuring that project-specific costs and risks are borne by the large-load customer, protecting existing ratepayers and creating incremental value for utilities and local communities. In its August 21, 2026 order, the Commission concluded: “After consideration of the entire record, the Commission finds that the proposed RESA contains adequate protections for existing customers, appropriately allocates financial and operational risks, establishes rates that are fair, just and reasonable, and provides for adequate and reliable service.” Under the approved structure, TeraWulf is responsible for the market, transmission, delivery and other costs attributable to serving its load, together with customer-specific infrastructure costs and substantial credit-support obligations.
[…]
The agreement also includes negotiated demand adders and customer charges that provide incremental contributions to Big Rivers Electric Corporation (“Big Rivers”) and Kenergy Corp.
[…]
The Justified Data Campus is being developed at the former Century Aluminum Hawesville facility, where approximately 482 MW of existing transmission capability remains available following the closure of the aluminum smelter.

projectSnapshot.name: Google West Memphis data center
projectSnapshot.rawStatus:
Google is good for Arkansas
  and great for Entergy customers
  Google is investing $4 billion on cloud and artificial intelligence infrastructure in
  Arkansas, including the development of a new data center in West Memphis
  – the company’s first facility in the state – powered by Entergy.
  Their historic investment in our state is bringing unparalleled benefits that will
  improve the lives of Arkansans for generations to come.


How will it benefit you?
           High tech partner = Lower cost power
           Google will cover the full energy costs associated with powering the facility, which will produce more
           than $1 billion in net customer savings over the life of the contract. In addition, as a new large industrial
           customer on our grid, Google will pick up more of the grid maintenance improvement costs that existing
           customers would otherwise have to bear alone and at a larger share than residential and small
           business customers.
           Adding any power-intensive facility to our grid can raise questions about its impact on service reliability
           for other customers, but we’ve ensured that our power service agreement with Google not only protects
           reliability for all customers, it improves it through measures such as:
           • Adding a new solar generation and battery storage facility in Jefferson County financially supported
             by Google.
           • Electrical infrastructure additions and improvements that will enhance reliability of the entire grid and
             lower costs for all customers.
           • A program to reduce data center power use during peak hours to support grid stability for all customers.

projectSnapshot.rawStatus: Type Turnkey or Powered Shell Location 145th Street, Little Rock, Pulaski County, AR Latitude & Longitude 34.623375 -92.246825 Acreage 296 acres 1,070 MW Total Baseload Power 570 MW Total Grid Power 500 MW Total Baseload BTM "AVAIO's campus is a generational investment in the power and digital infrastructure Arkansas needs to compete globally. Pulaski County Judge, Barry Hyde "AVAIO Digital's $6 billion data center hub represents the largest economic investment in Arkansas' history and sets the Natural State up to become a technology powerhouse that can compete with any state in the nation.” Governor, Sarah Huckabee Sanders AVAIO has broken ground on Project Leo, a 296-acre project with an initial fully contracted capacity online by 2027. sourceEvidence.name: Axios New Orleans: River Bend on-site construction visit, October 5
sourceEvidence.excerpt: As Hut 8 site manager Brennan Church sat at the front of the bus, he quipped that this project was "the first time I've had to deal with alligators on a construction site." He pointed out the infrastructure his team carved out of forested hunting land off a dead-end road near St. Francisville. There's the substation and a switchyard to manage the Entergy Louisiana power as it comes on site, and the equipment it takes to safely isolate the data center from the larger regional grid. There's the trestle bridge system crossing a field of rolling hills dotted with rebar and cranes to connect all that power, using 762,000 linear feet of cable, directly to the enormous data center itself. It'll take 1.5 million gallons of propylene glycol to keep it cool on a closed-loop system, Hut 8's Collier Pruner says, without having to draw on local water. In all, it's taking about 1,200 construction crew members working 24/7 to bring Hut 8's data center online by the first quarter of 2027, with full completion expected throughout next year.

In the south scope, the South East and South West Route would include a 345kV transmission line that would connect the proposed Mullet River Junction Substation, run south connecting to several intermediary substations, before terminating at the proposed Cedar Creek Junction in the Town of Jackson. Both routes would include a Common Route, consisting of two new 345kV transmission lines running parallel east to west to connect to the proposed intermediary Decker Substation in Port Washington. The proposed Decker Substation would also include the installation and connection of an Enhanced STATCOM (Static Synchronous Compensator) adjacent to it. The South East Route also would include building two new 138kV transmission circuits to connect to the proposed intermediary Adell Substation in Sherman Center and the existing Holland Substation.​
